summary: Parse one Robot file into raw call edges
description: Implement the first Robot Framework extractor slice: parse direct keyword calls from a single .robot or .resource file into raw graph edges.
scope: Add src/living_graph/robot_extractor.py
Add focused pytest tests under tests/test_robot_extractor.py
Use tiny fixtures from tests/fixtures
Return raw caller/callee relationships only
acceptanceCriteria: The extractor returns correctly attributed raw edges for tiny Robot Framework test cases and user keywords without producing edges for comments, blank lines, or metadata/settings lines.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not implement cross-file resolution in this task.
Do not implement Python AST parsing in this task.
Do not implement graph serialization or UI rendering in this task.

subtasks.title: Parse one test case direct keyword calls
subtasks.summary: Implement only enough Robot parsing to return two direct keyword call edges from one test case fixture.

relatedArtifacts.purpose: Tiny fixture with one test case calling two keywords.

scope: Add or update extract_robot_edges(path) in src/living_graph/robot_extractor.py
Given tests/fixtures/simple_test.robot, return exactly two edges in call order
Use the test case name as caller for both edges
Use the called keyword names as callee values
dataExamples: Fixture: *** Test Cases *** / Example Test / Keyword One / Keyword Two.
Expected edges in order: Example Test -> Keyword One, Example Test -> Keyword Two.
instructions: Write the failing test for this behavior first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q and confirm failure before implementation.
Implement only the minimal parser behavior for direct test case calls.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q again and stop when it passes.

subtasks.title: Parse user keyword body calls
subtasks.summary: Extend extract_robot_edges so a user keyword body call uses the keyword name as caller.

relatedArtifacts.purpose: Tiny fixture with one user keyword calling another keyword.

scope: Extend extract_robot_edges(path) for *** Keywords *** sections
Given tests/fixtures/simple_keywords.resource, return an edge from the user keyword to the called keyword
Do not change Task 1.1 behavior
dataExamples: Fixture: Keyword One keyword body calls Keyword Two.
Expected edge: Keyword One -> Keyword Two.
instructions: Add the failing user-keyword test first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q and confirm failure.
Implement the smallest extension to make it pass.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q.

subtasks.title: Handle keywords with zero calls
subtasks.summary: Ensure empty or Log-only keyword bodies do not raise and do not produce edges.
scope: Add a tiny fixture or inline test data with a user keyword that has no application keyword calls
Assert extract_robot_edges returns an empty list for that caller
Do not return None
dataExamples: Keyword body may be empty or contain only Log    Ready.
Expected result: no edges for that keyword body.
instructions: Add a failing zero-call test first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q and confirm failure.
Implement only the zero-call handling needed.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q.

subtasks.title: Handle multiple test cases in one file
subtasks.summary: Ensure calls from multiple test cases are attributed to the correct caller without cross-contamination.
scope: Add a fixture with two test cases, each calling a different keyword
Assert each edge caller is the correct test case name
Preserve call ordering within the file
dataExamples: Expected edges: First Case -> First Keyword, Second Case -> Second Keyword.
instructions: Add the failing multiple-test-case test first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q and confirm failure.
Implement only attribution isolation between test cases.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q.

subtasks.title: Ignore non-call Robot lines
subtasks.summary: Ignore comments, blanks, settings, documentation, and tags inside test cases or keyword bodies.
scope: Add fixture lines for comments, blanks, [Documentation], and [Tags]
Assert no spurious edges are emitted for non-call lines
Keep valid keyword call extraction unchanged
dataExamples: Ignore Robot setting rows like [Documentation] and [Tags].
Keep real keyword rows such as Verify Dashboard.
instructions: Add the failing ignore-lines test first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q and confirm failure.
Implement only filtering for non-call Robot rows.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_robot_extractor.py -q.

businessRules: Raw edges represent direct calls only.
Caller is the containing test case or user keyword name.
Callee is the first executable Robot keyword token on a call row.
Source file metadata is defined by GRAPH-002 contracts.
edgeCases: Empty keyword bodies produce an empty list, not None.
Multiple test cases in one file must not share caller state.
Comments, blank lines, and metadata rows are not calls.
